```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa")

# How big is it? (expect about 2.6 million rows, 7 columns)
nrow(ny_noaa)
ncol(ny_noaa)

# Date range: should be 1981-01-01 to 2010-12-31, matching the NOAA page
min(pull(ny_noaa, date))
max(pull(ny_noaa, date))


```
